acceptance_scope: Yahoo native market data and provider-only Chinese search with targeted backend/PostgreSQL/frontend regression, source equivalence and release package builds. No fresh full live-market/browser or production acceptance during release.
release_method: PR #5 merged to main; version/documentation release commit fast-forwarded to main; annotated v1.6.0 tag on the release commit; main and this tag pushed to origin.
source_commit_resolution: Resolve annotated v1.6.0^{commit} to obtain the final main release commit.
tag_relation: Runtime source, tests, dependencies and migrations identical to merged PR #5; release commit changes only root versions and release documentation/evidence.
deployment_scope: Source publication only; no container build, relabeling, instance switch or production migration/deployment.

rollback.effect: Removes Yahoo market data and this release's Chinese provider-only search. No runtime rollback is needed for this source-only release; deployed q18 migration rollback drops catalog metadata and must follow target-instance backup/runtime manifests.
